senses.gloss:
यापक a.
1 Causing to go.
--2
Giving, bestowing.

यापन a. (नी f.)
1 Causing to go or
go away.
--2 Curing.
--3 Mitigating.
--4 Supporting (life).
--नं, --ना
1
Causing to go away, driving out,
expulsion, removal.
--2 Cure or
alleviation (of a disease).
--3 Spending
or passing time, as in कालयापनं
--4
Delay, procrastination.
--5 Support,
maintenance.
--6 Practice, exercise.
--7 Loitering.

यापित a.
1 Spent, passed (time).
--2 Expelled, removed &c.

याप्य a.
1 To be removed,
expelled or rejected.
--2 Low,
contemptible, trifling, unimportant.
--Comp.
--यानं a litter or palanquin.
